messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: metering-service detected delayed ledger writes for the last 18m — customer-facing usage may be delayed and overage flags possible. Paging on-call.
maya: ack, jumping in. seeing a backlog on write-queue to billing-agg (kafka->ingest)
liam: any sign of token inflation or double-counting?
maya: initial check: counts aren't inflated, they're late. windowing shows tokens out-of-order for ~1.2% of shards.
sanjay: I'm seeing repeated replays from the emitter retries, could be causing duplicates that are deduped later — but that dedupe job is stuck.
tara: tagging support — Julie, we've got potential customer alerts for overages if reports backfill. Can you flag risk to CS? :warning:
julie: noted, will prep the short message for CS and queue a standby refund policy template in case customers see spikes.
maya: mitigation attempt 1: restarted dedupe-worker on staging-first, monitoring offsets. Logs: ```2026-03-17T16:02:11Z dedupe_worker error commit failed: timeout```
liam: if we can't clear backlog quickly, fallback plan to stop emitting overage notifications and mark alerts as delayed. Ops runbook?
maya: runbook step: (1) pause overage-email hook, (2) scale dedupe-workers x2, (3) trigger immediate compact of kafka topic partition 14, (4) track backfill ETA. Doing step 1 now.
deploy-bot: action: paused webhook for overage-alerts (user-facing) — runbook step 1 complete.
sanjay: scaling dedupe-workers now (requested nodes 2 -> 4). watching consumer lag.
maya: consumer lag dropping from ~380k -> 90k after restart, progress but still backlog.
tara: CS draft ready: short note + workaround + apology. Will hold send until we confirm backfill window.
liam: estimate for complete reconciliation? if current rate holds maybe 45–60m. Any faster path?
maya: if we compact partition and increase parallelism to 6 workers we could get ~20–30m. downside: CPU spike on billing nodes. Need ops OK.
sanjay: ops approve surge for 30m, but we'll need to watch Redis/KV pressure.
maya: triggering compact + scale to 6. Command: ```kc admin compact --topic metering-agg-2026 --partition 14 --force```
deploy-bot: job queued: compact started (job-id cb-881).
julie: prepping CS send-if: backfill ETA > 30m OR overage flags seen by customers.
tara: agree. waiting for confirmation.
maya: update: after compact + scale consumer lag at 12k and falling. projected full catch-up 22m.
liam: good. make sure we don't auto-unpause webhooks until dedupe catch-up complete.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigation in progress; severity reduced to SEV-3. No confirmed customer overages yet.
julie: sending standby message to CS channel (internal) with language and escalation contacts.
tara: once backfill completes we'll run a small sample validation query: ```select customer_id, sum(tokens) from ledger where ts between X and Y group by 1``` to confirm no double-counts.
maya: backfill complete at 1751212380 — validated sample sets, counts align within tolerance. will keep monitoring 2h.
liam: unpause webhooks after monitoring window? suggestion: wait 30m post-catchup.
maya: agreed. schedule: unpause at 1751214180 unless anomalies.
julie: CS on standby, will only notify customers if their account shows >10% variance or overage flag was triggered.
tara: thanks all — nice quick coordination. :thumbsup:
